authorization: User authorized all six routes and failure alternatives; no private account authority
constraints: BTCUSDT, original economic targets/window/capital/schedule unchanged, two independent runtime repos, manual300/5, no new795 unless final entrant unresolved dependencies and cost declared

route1.question: Does paired taker-flow flag forecast weaker cost-net seven-completed-day BTC return after controlling only PRIOR20d momentum and RMS volatility?
route1.outcome: spot completed close at last completed day to seven days later, subtract each project original round-trip fee/slip. Diagnostic only; no post-return market-control variable
route1.model: OLS intercept + veto + prior20d momentum + prior20d RMS; HC1 descriptive uncertainty; per-era models; no IID/prospective claim
route1.gate: >=10 veto-filled cohorts overall, >=3 each era; veto coefficient <= -.005 overall and <0 each era; >90% feature/forward coverage. Otherwise close information branch or insufficient support, never manufacture samples

route2.candidate: NEW BUY budget*.75 only when fixed paired flow flag; no strong-signal leverage increase, no held trades
route2.condition: Only if route1 qualifies. One alternative to original hard veto; at most two expressions per family
route2.control: same aggregate risk removal as uniform smaller new-entry budget; proxy event diagnostics do not scale curves or adopt defaults

route3.held_reassessment: Use accepted actual first-trim/first-HOLD basket, subsequent completed daily lows until actual close; rank downside removed per dollar versus uniform same removed inventory. No invented account MDD
route3.gate: >=10 independent episodes, each era>=3, dynamic removed-downside >= uniform downside*1.20, foregone net profit / removed-downside <=.50 (strictly positive risk removed); entrant only, no profit goal changes
route3.fallback_coin: Current target_fraction GAP=.10 replaced only for NEW BUY with max(.10, maximum observed one-day downside among20 completed returns). Existing RMS/7day/funding/fees/risk7.5 or3.6 and native macro stop cap unchanged. No held/topup expansion; actual committed entry target persists through existing Lifecycle
route3.fallback_spot: Census same new-entry tail source against adopted ATR trail; only if observed tail exceeds existing clipped ATR stress distance. No duplicate stop-budget variant already rejected
route3.fallback_gate: changed filled cohorts>=10, >=3 each era; actual hypothetical saved-lot net P/L >0 or registered downside/foregone-profit tradeoff passes. One fixed reserve, no threshold grid

source_order: BTC option implied volatility (Deribit public DVOL, finite latest historical day)
BTC ETF final flows (Farside table, publication/revision qualification only)
route4.requests: one bounded public read/source/sample, timeout5sec, max512KiB compressed/text; record UTC/status/hash and raw bytes, no retries, no private auth
route4.gate: Complete source/symbol/units/observation and actual receipt plus credible historical publication/vintage required; current snapshots never backfill history. Missing/blocked/retrospective final data -> explicit DATA_NOT_QUALIFIED with frozen manual research importer, no trading adapter
route4.fallback: OI absent/unqualified moves to option then ETF qualification; each source tried once; if none qualify, pending new public observations, not alpha failure

route5.method: Reuse accepted original filled cash/income and IOC journal; quantify fees/funding, true target/fill constraints and upper bound on justified savings; linear fee has no per-order fee, fragment consolidation alone cannot save commission
route5.gate: Only implement a concrete repeatable defect or cost mechanism with positive defensible net saving after altered fill risks; prior single-topup/cost-horizon rejects reused, no maker fill invention. Otherwise NO_JUSTIFIED_EXECUTION_CHANGE

route6.method: Reuse accepted71 report current selected actual2500/5000/7500 wallets, no scale or transfer, neutral5000+5000 remains reference; expose joint daily downside, correlation and simultaneous gross exposure; daily MDD not continuous joint MDD
route6.gate: No historical-best ratio chosen; inspect whether new overall risk constraint is unaddressed. Existing fixed allocation evidence reused; no dynamic cash transfer daemon. Material unaddressed mechanism would need separately financed account test

entrants.capital: independent coldCNY10000, actual finite original starts subset
entrants.base_reuse: Only old matching protected runtime/meter/input/schedule/window/conditions; keep old producer identity
entrants.accept: all money/operating gates, >=1 actual treatment event, and each window improves wealth without >1ppMDD rise OR improves MDD>=20% with finalwealth>=95%baseline; final full adoption would require declared exact comparison, not automatic795

budget.cache: small1d/4h parse once within invocation, immutable baseline projections, no14GB rescan

termination: Complete all six routes regardless of first branch failure. Close max2expressions per information family, different mechanism next. No qualified entrant after all routes is a completed negative/data-pending delivery; ceiling not proven.
